content: The $\alpha $ , in the full system, is set to be 1, which means that minimizing the loss in predicting either type of discourse relations is equally important. In the evaluation, we will also evaluate a system variant, where we will set $\alpha = 0$ , which means that the neural network will not attempt to predict explicit discourse relations and implicit discourse relation prediction will not be influenced by predicting neighboring explicit discourse relations.
